records.text: He (Justin Baldoni) did tell me one thing that was really disturbing, and I have to share it. He doesn't actually drink kombucha. He's not a big kombucha drinker. So I kind of wrote this little piece of fan fiction. I will not accept it. I feel like he will forever be a kombucha drinker in our minds, and he's fine with the fact that he owes me kombucha, but he's a kombucha drinker.
